title: Zenith: Scaling up Ranking Models for Billion-scale Livestreaming Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2601.21285v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurately capturing feature interactions is essential in recommender systems, and recent trends show that scaling up model capacity could be a key driver for next-level predictive performance. While prior work has explored various model architectures to capture multi-granularity feature interactions, relatively little attention has been paid to efficient feature handling and scaling model capacity without incurring excessive inference latency. In this paper, we address this challenge by presenting Zenith, a scalable and efficient ranking architecture that learns complex feature interactions with minimal runtime overhead. Zenith uses Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) as a common capacity-scaling mechanism across feature interaction and long-sequence encoding, while adapting its parameterization to each token regime. translated_title: Zenith：面向十亿级直播推荐场景的可扩展排序模型
translated_abstract: 在推荐系统中，准确捕捉特征交互至关重要，近期的趋势表明，扩大模型容量可能是实现更高预测性能的关键驱动力。尽管先前的工作已经探索了多种模型架构来捕捉多粒度的特征交互，但在高效特征处理以及在不引入过多推理延迟的前提下扩展模型容量方面，所受到的关注相对较少。在本文中，我们通过提出 Zenith 来应对这一挑战，Zenith 是一种可扩展且高效的排序架构，能够以最小的运行时开销学习复杂的特征交互。Zenith 采用稀疏混合专家模型（SMoE）作为特征交互和长序列编码的统一容量扩展机制，并针对不同的 token 类型调整其参数化方式。特征交互单元对一小组固定的高维 Prime 特征应用逐 token 注意力和 SMoE……
tldr: 本文提出 Zenith，一种以稀疏混合专家（SMoE）为核心的可扩展高效排序架构，通过在特征交互和长序列编码中统一扩展模型容量，在十亿级直播推荐场景下以最小的推理延迟开销学习复杂特征交互。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Zenith, a scalable and efficient ranking architecture that leverages Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) as a unified capacity-scaling mechanism across feature interaction and long-sequence encoding, learning complex feature interactions with minimal inference latency for billion-scale livestreaming recommendation.
